operations.name: Home

operations.body: query Libraries { libraries(page: { size: 100 }) { __typename nodes { __typename id title itemCount coverUrl } } }
operations.name: Libraries

operations.body:
query Library($id: ID!, $page: PageInput) { library(id: $id) { __typename id title description itemCount items(page: $page) { __typename totalCount nodes { __typename ...MediaCard } } } }
fragment MediaCard on Media { __typename id title durationMs coverUrl favorite progress { __typename positionMs durationMs watched } }
operations.name: Library

operations.body:
query Playlists { playlists(page: { size: 100 }) { __typename nodes { __typename ...PlaylistCard } } }
fragment PlaylistCard on Playlist { __typename id title itemCount coverUrl favorite }
operations.name: Playlists
Playlist

operations.body:
query Channels { channels { __typename ...ChannelCard description } }
fragment ChannelCard on Channel { __typename id title onAir favorite }
operations.name: Channels

operations.body:
query Media($id: ID!) { media(id: $id) { __typename ...MediaCard description createdAt } }
fragment MediaCard on Media { __typename id title durationMs coverUrl favorite progress { __typename positionMs durationMs watched } }
operations.name: Media

operations.body:
query Search($text: String!) { search(text: $text, page: { size: 40 }) { __typename totalCount nodes { __typename ...MediaCard } } }
fragment MediaCard on Media { __typename id title durationMs coverUrl favorite progress { __typename positionMs durationMs watched } }
operations.name: Search

operations.body:
query Me { me { __typename id name email deviceLimit deliveryBlock device { __typename ...DeviceFields } } }
fragment DeviceFields on Device { __typename id name platform appVersion lastSeenAt createdAt current }
operations.name: Me

operations.body:
query Devices { devices { __typename ...DeviceFields } }
fragment DeviceFields on Device { __typename id name platform appVersion lastSeenAt createdAt current }
operations.name: Devices

operations.body:
mutation DeviceRegister($input: DeviceRegisterInput!) { deviceRegister(input: $input) { __typename ...DeviceFields } }
fragment DeviceFields on Device { __typename id name platform appVersion lastSeenAt createdAt current }
operations.name: DeviceRegister

operations.body:
mutation DeviceRename($id: ID!, $name: String!) { deviceRename(id: $id, name: $name) { __typename ...DeviceFields } }
fragment DeviceFields on Device { __typename id name platform appVersion lastSeenAt createdAt current }
operations.name: DeviceRename

operations.body: mutation MarkWatched($mediaId: ID!, $watched: Boolean!) { markWatched(mediaId: $mediaId, watched: $watched) { __typename positionMs watched } }
operations.name: MarkWatched

operations.body: mutation PlaybackStart($input: PlaybackStartInput!) { playbackStart(input: $input) { __typename url expiresAt title durationMs chapters { __typename startMs title } coverUrl previewManifestUrl resumePositionMs } }
operations.name: PlaybackStart
